model: Unchanged zero-background Moore ASM; threshold8, one grain per direction on each harvest; offboard directions sink; v=u-K

prefix.definition: First90 recorded successful harvests in the existing observation window; original event order including ties
prefix.meaning: Matches input count, not elapsed time; ninety does not identify individual initial tokens
prefix.nontrivial_event: Direct-neighbor v-event has positive toppling count, equivalent to q8 event topplings>1
prefix.maximum_area: max_event_u_area includes the guaranteed source site as in previous q8 events; max_event_v_area is also supplied

spatial.operation: Uniformly permute full-terminal K map positions, retaining its histogram and total; each replicate starts at zero on the same graph
spatial.scalar_difference: Actual total u or v minus mean shuffle total; v/K difference is the same v difference divided by fixed trial K total
spatial.map_difference: Actual u or v field minus its own shuffle mean field; separate differences because local K positions change
spatial.interpretation: Descriptive sensitivity within this model, not a causal adjustment, CPR-feasible counterfactual, or significance test

aggregation: Mean trials within each pair_id, then average ten pair_id means equally per condition; descriptive only, no independence assumption or p-values
participant_overlap: Pair IDs may share participant labels according to separate audit; inferential claims are intentionally omitted
